rv.q: The six attractive performers four of whom appear continually as other characters are good company and keep the show moving.
At 30 minutes it might be fun. As a full-fledged two-act, it becomes pretty boring.
That Parenting Musical consistently aims for the lowest common denominator; its gags are often only marginally better than the 'Dad jokes' it repeatedly parodies.
It is two hours of rib-tickling fun.

cn.t: This musical revue about parenting's trials earns mixed reviews, with critics split between those charmed by its whimsical, rib-tickling humor and those finding its focus on parenthood's lows more exhausting than entertaining.
